pages.title: Spell Books
pages.description: Accessing higher  tier spells will  require a better  spell book. While a  novice spell book  only has access to  Tier 1 spells, the  Apprentice and  Archmage spell books  will unlock tiers  two and three.  Upgrading your spell  book will transfer  all of the spells
that you have  learned into your  new book. Books may  be dyed by crafting  them with a piece of  dye.

pages.title: Protection of the 4 elements
pages.description: This book upgrade will protect your spellbook from all kinds of damage, may it be a cactus or a pool of lava. Can't guarantee on the void. The gold inlays will become netherite-black but you can toggle it off in the client configs.
